ruleset.name: no-raw-json
ruleset.description: Tests use DTOs: payloads are objects serialized when sent, and responses/messages are deserialized into DTOs before asserting. Hand-written JSON (a string literal or text block that looks like JSON) is allowed only inside a method annotated @RawJsonPayload(reason = ...), for negative scenarios a DTO cannot express (wrong JSON type, missing-vs-null field, broken JSON, malformed message). Applies to all test code, harness/ plumbing and the e2e framework; the services' and common's production code is excluded.

rule.name: NoRawJsonOutsideRawJsonPayload
rule.message: Hand-written JSON: send/assert DTOs (Json.write / Json.read); raw JSON only in a @RawJsonPayload(reason) method
rule.description: Flags a string literal or text block that looks like JSON - a quoted key followed by a colon, an object start with a key ({"), or an array start followed by JSON ([{ [" [1) - unless an enclosing method declaration carries @RawJsonPayload (its own annotation data tables count as inside it). A lone brace and the empty "{}" / "[]" are not flagged: they are also SLF4J placeholders and path templates, and carry no field a DTO could express.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //StringLiteral [matches(@Image, '\\"[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*\\"\s*:') or matches(@Image, '^"""[\s\S]*"[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*"\s*:') or matches(@Image, '^"\s*\{\s*\\"') or matches(@Image, '^"""\s*\{\s*"') or matches(@Image, '^"\s*\[\s*(\{|\\"|-?[0-9])') or matches(@Image, '^"""\s*\[\s*(\{|"|-?[0-9])')] [not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'RawJsonPayload']])]
